title: With threats to midterms, states say Trump administration isn’t helping
description: U.S. spy agencies see Russia and others plotting to sow distrust and misinformation in the upcoming elections.

title: How Democrats hope to reverse Trump’s changes to the presidency
description: As the midterms approach, some of the president’s foes are working to ensure his aggressive approach to executive power doesn’t outlast him.

title: Should Big Oil pay for climate change? A Supreme Court case will help decide.
description: Boulder, Colo., is hoping its novel lawsuit will be the environmental equivalent of the landmark litigation that produced billions in damages and settlements against Big Tobacco and opioid makers.

title: An election chief lost. Then he padlocked the ballots and called the FBI.
description: Shasta County, California, where election doubts run so deep that some don’t trust results even when their choice prevails, offers a glimpse of what happens when distrust in voting systems takes root.

title: How Roy Cooper became Democrats’ best chance to flip a Senate seat
description: The former North Carolina governor is running in a state that for decades has more often preferred Republicans for federal office.

title: Politics chat: Midterm polls, Senate races, Trump in Texas
description: As polls come out with increasing frequency closer to the midterm election, how much credence should voters give them? Meanwhile, President Trump continues campaigning for GOP candidates.

title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
description: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

title: Trump announces plan to send $90 payments to millions of seniors
description: The White House said the one-time payments would be drawn from a fund set up to improve Medicare.

title: Trump reveals Tom Cotton’s phone number in daylight saving time standoff
description: The GOP senator, usually a staunch Trump ally, has vowed to oppose efforts for year-round daylight saving time. He reiterated his opposition Saturday.

title: Why this Democrat is struggling in a state that rejects Trump
description: New Hampshire’s Senate race is considered a toss-up thanks to voters’ independent streak and the GOP candidate’s name recognition.

title: A record number of Native Americans are running in the 2026 midterms
description: At least 355 Native American and Indigenous candidates ran or are running in local, state and federal primary and general elections this year — a record number.

title: Four fears and frustrations that are shaping Brazil’s election. One is Trump.
description: Officials in Brazil have grown increasingly concerned about the possibility of U.S. interference in the presidential vote on Sunday.

title: Tennessee’s botched execution highlights unsettled state of death penalty in America
description: Botched executions like Christa Pike’s have also fueled new calls to halt executions, with death penalty opponents saying the Tennessee case shows its inherent cruelty.

title: Week in Politics: Inflation pressure; war in Iran and effect on midterm elections
description: We look at how some concerning economic indicators as well as the ongoing war in Iran might affect the midterm elections.

title: How high-profile scandals are shaping key contests ahead of the midterms
description: Scandals could be shaping several races in the midterm elections, particularly in places where even small margins can change the outcome.

title: California voters to decide on controversial one-time tax on billionaires
description: California voters will decide whether the state will charge a one-time tax on billionaires. The idea that has split Democrats and labor unions.

title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
description: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

title: Trump revisits the scene of his political ascent as Republicans struggle
description: A month before the midterms, the president returned to Alabama and other places where his movement remains strongest.

title: Trump heads back to Texas on Wednesday as GOP fights to keep state red
description: Texas, long a safe Republican state, has emerged as a top battleground in midterm races up and down the ballot — but especially in the U.S. Senate race.

title: DOJ probe into Trump foes sees another prominent departure
description: Kurt Olsen, who previously worked as Trump’s election security czar, resigned from the “grand conspiracy” investigation on Monday.

title: Christa Pike was on ventilator, unconscious after botched lethal injection, lawyers say
description: In a court filing, attorneys for Christa Pike allege that Tennessee officials failed to follow their own lethal injection protocol.

title: Ex-congressman and Rubio ally gets 10 years for secret Venezuela lobbying
description: Former congressman David Rivera (R-Florida) maintained that, despite a $50 million lobbying contract from Venezuela’s government, he advocated for the removal of President Nicolás Maduro.

title: Top Senate GOP-aligned super PAC pauses N.C. spending, in sign of deepening woes
description: The Senate Leadership Fund’s pulling money from North Carolina is the latest signal the Republican Party is giving up hope of holding that Senate seat.

title: Talarico, Paxton launch dueling ads amid heated Senate race in Texas
description: Both contenders are airing spots intended to address perceived vulnerabilities.

title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
description: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

title: How Trump keeps embracing AI
description: And what else happened this week under his administration.

title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
description: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

title: Midterm polls that caught our eye this week show more good news for Democrats
description: Polls show close contests in competitive Senate races and rare independent polling in Virginia congressional races.

title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
description: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
description: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.
